screenshots.name: wh-writeoffs-list
screenshots.description: Write-offs history tab showing list of write-off documents with status badges, filters, and summary footer
screenshots.desiredState: Write-offs page fully loaded with the History tab active. Table shows write-off rows with columns: document number, date, department, reason, total value, and status badges (in-progress / completed / abandoned).
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the write-offs history list tab — not the analytics tab, not the pending confirmation tab, not the creation modal

mustShow: Write-off table rows or empty state

screenshots.name: wh-writeoffs-create
screenshots.description: Write-off creation modal with dual-panel form showing item selection from department inventory and reason fields
screenshots.desiredState: Write-off creation modal is open on top of the write-offs page. The modal shows header fields (date, document number, department dropdown, reason) and a dual-panel item picker or line items section.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the write-off creation form as a modal overlay — not the history list page behind it

stateSetup.description: Click the Create Write-off button in the page header to open the creation modal

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (var b of btns) { var rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.top < 120 && b.textContent.trim().length > 0 && rect.width > 80) { b.click(); return 'clicked header action button'; } } return 'no button found'; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The create button selector may need adjustment based on actual DOM structure.

mustNotShow: Only the list page without modal

screenshots.name: wh-writeoffs-analytics
screenshots.description: Write-offs analytics tab showing grouped view by document number with totals
screenshots.desiredState: Write-offs page with the Analytics tab active. View shows write-offs grouped by document number with aggregated totals.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the analytics/grouped tab — not the history list tab, not the pending confirmation tab

stateSetup.description: Navigate to write-offs page and click the Analytics tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); if (tabs.length >= 2) { tabs[1].click(); return 'clicked second tab (analytics)'; } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: The Analytics tab may be at a different index. Adjust if needed.

screenshots.name: wh-writeoffs-confirmation
screenshots.description: Pending confirmation tab showing write-offs awaiting approval with confirm and reject actions
screenshots.desiredState: Write-offs page with the Pending Confirmation tab active. Shows write-offs that need approval with action buttons for confirm and reject.
screenshots.differentiator: Shows the pending confirmation tab — not the history tab, not the analytics tab

stateSetup.description: Navigate to write-offs page and click the Pending Confirmation tab

interactionSequence.script: (() => { var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'); if (tabs.length >= 3) { tabs[2].click(); return 'clicked third tab (pending confirmation)'; } if (tabs.length >= 2) { tabs[tabs.length - 1].click(); return 'clicked last tab'; } return 'tabs not found, count: ' + tabs.length; })()

screenshots.knownLimitation: If no pending write-offs exist, an empty state will be shown.

mustShow: Write-off rows with action buttons or empty state
